instruction: Change the VS Code icon in the taskbar to the custom icon image in Downloads.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not provide any built-in functionality to change its application icon. The icon is part of the application bundle and cannot be modified through VS Code's settings or extensions without system-level modifications.

llm_judge_reasons: Correct use of 'infeasible' evaluator for a task that cannot be completed as stated
VS Code does not provide built-in functionality to change its application icon through settings or extensions
The infeasible marker function is the semantically appropriate evaluator for this scenario
Metadata explanation accurately describes why the task is infeasible
